# Brotli -- vendored for Aver

**Upstream:** https://github.com/google/brotli
**Version:** v1.2.0, commit `028fb5a23661f123017c060daa546b55cf4bde29` (2025-10-27)
**Licence:** MIT (`LICENSE`).
**Approved:** by the owner for WOFF2 font decoding (Godot feature parity, docs/plans/GODOT_PARITY.md), 2026-10-31.

Only the decoder is used. Kept from upstream, unmodified: `c/common`, `c/dec`, `c/include`, `LICENSE`. The encoder is not vendored.
